parent_formula.criticality_certificate: The full 8-clause set is the unique clause subset of deficiency 2; every proper clause subset has deficiency at most 1. Therefore delta*(F)=2 and F is maximum-deficiency-critical.

siblings.branchwise_rank_effect: parent 2 -> siblings 0 and 1; both are strict descendants and both are SAT

signed_transport_exhaustion.transport_definition: A valid source-to-target transport is a signed permutation pi such that for every target clause C there exists a source clause D with D subseteq pi(C).
signed_transport_exhaustion.conclusion: Neither sibling semantically covers the other through the R44BP signed-subsumption transport class.

meaning: R44BP is a genuine exact safe-deletion primitive where a certificate exists.
R44BQ-K5 gives polynomial discovery on a nontrivial infinite family.
R44BQ-NPHARD blocks generic unbounded discovery on arbitrary sibling pairs unless P=NP.
R44BR now additionally proves that maximum-deficiency criticality alone does not guarantee existence of any signed-permutation subsumption transport in either direction.
